title: The Ultimate Item Toolkit
description: Get a Shulker Box with every item in the game using a single command. The perfect toolkit for builders, testers, and creators
body:
🇺🇸 English Version (Original) ## 📦 OmniBox: Every Single Item in One Command! Tired of scrolling through the creative inventory or typing dozens of commands to test blocks, custom mechanics, or resource packs? **OmniBox** is the ultimate universal utility datapack that gives you instant access to **every single item** available, neatly organized into 19 distinct Shulker Boxes. Built with compatibility in mind, this datapack is designed to work seamlessly across **all Minecraft versions**, saving you hours of tedious work. Whether you are a map maker, a server admin, a survival player looking to test builds, or a developer checking texture pack compatibility, OmniBox is the perfect tool for you. --- ## ✨ Features * **Universal Compatibility:** Designed to run smoothly on any Minecraft version. * **19 Custom Shulkers:** Spawns a full set of Shulker Boxes containing every block, item, tool, armor piece, and spawn egg. * **Smart Organization:** Items are sorted logically so you can find exactly what you need in seconds. * **Optimized for Creators:** Perfect for quick testing, inventory setups, or showcase worlds. * **Lightweight & Clean:** No lag, no permanent background loops, just pure efficiency. --- ## 🚀 How to Use Simply open your chat and type the following command: `/function allitems:give_shulkers` *(Note: Ensure cheats are enabled on your world or that you have operator status (OP) on your server to execute functions!)* --- ## 🛠️ Installation 1. Download the datapack `.zip` file. 2. Put it inside the `datapacks` folder of your Minecraft world save. 3. Type `/reload` in-game (or restart your world), and you are ready to go! --- ## 🏷️ Tags & Keywords Vanilla Utility, Admin Tools, Creative Mode, Item Spawner, Utility Datapack, Developer Tools, Map Making, All Items Command, Cheat, Shulker Box Setup.
